title: Brand spot files match their actual fitted geometry, reviewed side image and existing site-check ink rule
steps: Run the brand spot image and composed/name-only fitting tests without a model or database.
expect: A raw 512x512 mark formerly accepted for a 128x80 spot is rejected before a site write.
A passing review of a recoloured side mark cannot approve another final file; blocked actual ink remains rejected even with a passing look.
The standalone mark path fits the selected existing source to a transparent 256x160 output without a business name.
The approved composed-logo default remains valid, and missing, opaque, empty or escaping mark inputs are rejected.
New runs record the spot check version; historical runs explicitly retain their original checker.
fence: Validate actual files before writes; preserve independent image review, the approved prompt and the existing site-check contrast thresholds.

tests: the complete legacy gate accepts a raw 512 square; the new frozen gate rejects that actual file
reviewing a recoloured side mark does not cover an unrecoloured actual spot
fit_logo markOnly supports held names and writes a real 2x transparent spot
fit_logo markOnly rejects escaping paths and empty transparent marks
